name: GoodHire
summary: GoodHire, which calls itself a Checkr company, lists three per-check packages from $29.99 to $94.99 with third-party fees extra. It offers three consent routes (e-consent by email, its own form, or the employer's form) and connects to applicant tracking systems such as Greenhouse, Lever and Workday.

facts.text: GoodHire's pricing page describes the company as a Checkr company and lists the same three package prices as Checkr's workforce plans.
GoodHire offers three FCRA consent options: e-consent signed by the candidate on a phone or computer, a GoodHire consent form for onsite candidates, and a custom employer form that GoodHire reviews.
The integrations page says GoodHire comes pre-integrated with leading ATS and HRIS platforms and can be added to others through its API.
The pricing page says additional third-party fees may apply and does not state the amounts.
